headline: Senate confirms National Intelligence Director Clayton 51-47 as SEED Act advances toward final vote!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate confirmed Walter Clayton of New York as Director of National Intelligence by a 51-47 vote. Senators also achieved a cloture agreement on the motion to proceed to H.R. 5334, the SEED Act, which provides early childhood educator tax deductions, clearing the way for continued debate.
